dublinCore.dc:title: 116 HR 5363 IH: Fostering Undergraduate Talent by Unlocking Resources for Education Act
dublinCore.dc:rights: Pursuant to Title 17 Section 105 of the United States Code, this file is not subject to copyright protection and is in the public domain.

action.action-desc: Ms. Adams introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Education and Labor

form.official-title: To reauthorize mandatory funding programs for historically Black colleges and universities and other minority-serving institutions, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Fostering Undergraduate Talent by Unlocking Resources for Education Act or the FUTURE Act.

Section 371(b)(1)(A) of the Higher Education Act of 1965 (20 U.S.C. 1067q(b)(1)(A)) is amended by striking for each of the fiscal years 2008 through 2019. and all that follows through the end of the subparagraph and inserting for fiscal year 2020 and each fiscal year thereafter..

section.header: Increased funding for Federal Pell Grants
section.text: Section 401(b)(7)(A)(iv) of the Higher Education Act of 1965 (20 U.S.C. 1070a(b)(7)(A)(iv)) is amended—

paragraph.text: in subclause (X), by striking $1,430,000,000 and inserting $1,455,000,000; and
in subclause (XI), by striking $1,145,000,000 and inserting $1,170,000,000.
